    - name: Build sing-box from source (mipsle)
      run: |
        SB_TAG=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/SagerNet/sing-box/releases/latest | grep '"tag_name"' | cut -d'"' -f4)
        echo "Latest sing-box version: $SB_TAG"
        [ -z "$SB_TAG" ] && SB_TAG="v1.13.12"
        sudo apt-get update -y
        sudo apt-get install -y golang-go
        go version
        git clone --depth=1 --branch "$SB_TAG" https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box.git /tmp/sing-box-src
        cd /tmp/sing-box-src
        export GOOS=linux
        export GOARCH=mipsle
        export GOMIPS=softfloat
        export CGO_ENABLED=0
        go build -trimpath \
          -tags "with_quic,with_grpc,with_wireguard,with_utls,with_clash_api" \
          -ldflags "-s -w -X github.com/sagernet/sing-box/constant.Version=${SB_TAG}" \
          -o ${{ github.workspace }}/sing-box.bin \
          ./cmd/sing-box
        ls -la ${{ github.workspace }}/sing-box.bin
        echo "SB_TAG=${SB_TAG}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
